minutes.headline: Board approved an ANR at 1325 Mass Ave and recommended the town not pursue the Leominster Road land purchase right.
minutes.summary: The board approved an ANR plan creating a second lot at 1325 Massachusetts Avenue and continued the 525 Chase Road site plan hearing two weeks to await the engineering review. It voted to recommend against pursuing the right of first refusal on parcel 4 Leominster Road. It also discussed a parking-lot solar bylaw amendment aimed at a fall special town meeting and a draft common driveway bylaw that the land use director will research further.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted to recommend that the town not pursue the right of first refusal on parcel 4 Leominster Road.
The board approved an ANR plan for 1325 Massachusetts Avenue by voice vote.
The board continued the 525 Chase Road site plan hearing to July 24, and will not approve it until the town engineer's review is back.
Board members discussed the Community Preservation Act as a fund for last-minute land purchases, noting that adoption has failed three times before.
The land use director will draft a parking-lot solar bylaw amendment and return the common driveway draft at the next meeting.

why_it_matters: The Leominster Road recommendation goes to whoever decides on the town's right of first refusal, and it bears on whether the town acquires that land.
The Community Preservation Act discussion touches how the town could fund future land purchases, a question that would need a town vote to adopt.
The solar and common driveway bylaws, if brought forward, would change what property owners may build and would need town meeting votes.
